skill.name: internationalization-helper
skill.description: Finds hardcoded UI strings, organizes translation keys, checks locale coverage, and guides pluralization, formatting, and RTL support.
skill.summary: Helps teams prepare application text and locale files for multi-language support.
skill.author: CrazyDubya

content.value_statement: Multi-language applications often miss hardcoded text and uneven locale coverage. This skill guides extraction, key organization, and translation file checks for safer i18n work.
actual_capabilities: Identifies common i18n frameworks in JavaScript, Vue, Python, and Ruby projects.
Guides searches for hardcoded user-facing strings in UI files and templates.
Suggests translation key organization by feature, common area, and usage context.
Compares locale files conceptually to find missing translation keys.
Explains pluralization, number formatting, date formatting, and RTL layout considerations.
Provides a sample locale file structure for common buttons, auth text, validation, and messages.
limitations: It does not provide automatic machine translation or human translation review.
It does not validate every framework-specific configuration option.
It cannot guarantee cultural accuracy for localized copy.
It relies on the agent and project tools to inspect actual application files.

use_cases.title: Prepare a React App for Localization
use_cases.description: Find visible English text, propose translation keys, and map each string to existing locale files.

use_cases.title: Review Locale Coverage Before Release
use_cases.description: Compare expected translation keys across locales and list missing or inconsistent entries before shipping.

use_cases.title: Improve Translator Handoff
use_cases.description: Organize keys by feature and add context so translators understand labels, errors, and dynamic messages.

prompt_templates.title: Find Hardcoded Strings
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit for a small feature or page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this feature for hardcoded user-facing strings. List each string, its file, and a suggested translation key.

prompt_templates.title: Create Translation Keys
prompt_templates.scenario: Move visible text into a locale file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the visible text from this component into translation keys. Keep the key names stable and grouped by feature.

prompt_templates.title: Check Locale Coverage
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare existing language files before release.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the base locale with the other locales. Report missing keys, extra keys, and entries that need translator review.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Advanced I18n Support
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare complex product areas for many locales.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this area for pluralization, date formatting, number formatting, and RTL layout needs. Recommend concrete implementation changes.

output_examples.input: A settings page contains English labels, buttons, helper text, and validation errors.
output: Hardcoded strings found in headings, form labels, buttons, and error messages.
Suggested keys use settings.profile, common.buttons, and validation namespaces.
Validation messages need placeholders for field names and minimum lengths.

output_examples.input: A product has English, Spanish, and French locale files before a release.
output: Spanish is missing profile biography and privacy title entries.
French matches the base locale key set.
Two shared button labels should move into a common namespace.

output_examples.input: A team wants to add Arabic support to an existing interface.
output: Review page direction, form alignment, icons, and spacing for RTL behavior.
Replace left and right spacing rules with logical properties.
Check date, currency, and plural message handling for the new locale.

best_practices: Use stable keys that describe context, not the current source text.
Keep shared strings in common namespaces and feature-specific strings near their product area.
Test layouts with long translated strings, plural forms, and right-to-left languages.
anti_patterns: Do not concatenate translated fragments to build user-facing sentences.
Do not use source English text as the only translation key strategy.
Do not ship a new locale without checking missing keys and dynamic placeholders.

faq.question: Does this skill translate text automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps organize and audit translation work, but translators or translation services still provide localized copy.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it mention?
faq.answer: It covers common patterns for React, Vue, Python, Ruby, gettext, i18next, react-intl, and related tools.

faq.question: Can it find missing translations?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides comparison of locale files to identify missing keys, extra keys, and likely coverage gaps.

faq.question: Can it help with plural forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains plural categories and encourages locale-aware message handling for counts and dynamic values.

faq.question: Does it support right-to-left languages?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for direction settings and logical CSS properties for Arabic and Hebrew layouts.

faq.question: Is it safe for private repositories?
faq.answer: The skill only requests file reading, searching, and editing tools. Review generated changes before committing them.
